covered.title: AI vs machine learning vs deep learning
covered.hook: AI, machine learning, and deep learning are not the same thing.
covered.analogy: Think of cooking. AI is cooking in general, any way a machine can act smart. Machine learning is learning recipes by tasting thousands of di
covered.example: ChatGPT is deep learning, which makes it machine learning, which makes it AI. All three labels fit.

covered.title: What is a neural network?
covered.hook: AI doesn't think. It does math. Billions of times.

covered.title: What is a token?
covered.hook: ChatGPT has never read a single word you typed.
covered.analogy: Think of LEGO. The model can't swallow a whole sentence at once, so your text gets snapped into bricks, and every brick is one token.
covered.example: That's why AI can struggle to count the R's in strawberry. It never sees letters. It only sees tokens.
